pr_body:
Reverts #51255
Fixes #51486 

Adds a regression test.
pr_comments: Fast-track has been requested by @mcollina. Please 👍 to approve.

> apparently some of our machines are suffering

The issue seems to be the backlog for the osx CI is growing faster than the CI is eating it. Would it be possible to disable that job until the queue is gone instead?

> The issue seems to be the backlog for the osx CI is growing faster than the CI is eating it. Would it be possible to disable that job until the queue is gone instead?

All the `osx11-x64` machines are offline https://ci.nodejs.org/label/osx11-x64/

> @BethGriggs, there are still jobs for OS X pending.

Yes(?). I was just mentioning that it's not a case of CI not keeping up - the pending queue will not be processed at all until one of those machines is brought back online.
The main CI job does not complete because it's waiting for OSX machine, therefore the flaky test we are experiencing cannot be restarted, and the release with the revert go out.
@UlisesGascon are you around and able to look at the osx machine issue ?
Just a reminder that in a case like this opening an issue in the build repo may make it more visible that help is needed, I went ahead and did that here - https://github.com/nodejs/build/issues/3612
